parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 直播流名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看StreamName
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the callback is successful. Valid values:
success: Successful.
failed: Failed
parameters.help_zh:
回调是否成功。
success：成功。
failed：失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

The start time must be within the last 7 days
parameters.help_zh:
起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

开始时间必须在近7天内
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。结束时间需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500. Valid values: any integer from 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认20，最大500。取值：1~500之前的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size

AppName.description_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs

Description.description_en: The result description. The value is success if the callback is successful. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Description.description_zh: 结果描述，为success时成功，失败则返回错误信息

NotifyContent.description_en: The specific content of the callback

NotifyHeader.description_en: The request header of the callback request

NotifyResponse.description_en: The response returned by the user after receiving the callback
NotifyResponse.description_zh: 用户端接受回调后返回的响应结果

NotifyResult.description_en:
The callback result. Valid values:
success: Successful.
failed: Failed
NotifyResult.description_zh:
回调结果。
success：成功。
failed：失败

NotifyTime.description_en: The time when the callback occurred (UTC)

NotifyType.description_en:
The callback type. Valid values:
publish: a stream ingest event.
publish_done: a stream disconnection event
NotifyType.description_zh:
回调类型。
publish：表示推流事件。
publish_done：表示断流事件

StreamName.description_en: The name of the live stream

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of entries that match the specified conditions
